subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The implementation is focused and covered, but it deliberately changes which transcript rows may become requester-visible A2A replies, and green CI cannot prove every live channel history shape.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message subtype and leaves reverse sessions_send and compaction replay fixes to separate work.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent production-channel run shows one requester-visible delivery with no duplicate.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Plan
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the mirror, reverse-send, requester return-path, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated as one delivery design.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message subtype and leaves reverse sessions_send and compaction replay fixes to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the closest recent history on delivery-mirror artifact identity, sessions_send delivery, and adjacent QA coverage.
